## Evidence

- [ ] Before and after evidence is attached or linked.
- [ ] Required states were exercised, including loading, empty, error, success, restricted, and long-content states where relevant.
- [ ] Mobile (390), tablet (768), desktop (1280), and wide (1440) behavior was checked where relevant.
- [ ] Keyboard order, visible focus, screen-reader semantics, zoom, and reduced motion were checked.
- [ ] Visual-regression and accessibility results are linked, or the missing coverage is recorded below.
- [ ] Console/runtime errors and horizontal overflow were checked on materially changed experiences.

## Studio-grade definition of done

- [ ] Purpose, location, status, and primary action are clear.
- [ ] Required states and breakpoints behave intentionally.
- [ ] The experience is keyboard-operable and uses approved semantic tokens and patterns.
- [ ] Loading, saving, success, and failure feedback is complete.
- [ ] Content, performance, and implementation fidelity were reviewed.
- [ ] The experience is registered and has no unresolved release-blocking design finding.
